breakdowns.site: Vadodara Fleet — Machine 0841 (SN: 9FW-HK-HB108CF / 0841) Battery Cell Boiling & Steering Sensor Defect
breakdowns.issue: Sole machine at Vadodara grounded since 8:00 PM last night, halting client warehouse operations. Operator reported severe battery cell boiling: upon pouring DM water, water immediately boils away with heavy smoke emission. Machine also requires 1 steering sensor (logged ~1 week ago in Google Form by Asim). Client calling continuously for restoration.
breakdowns.action: Dhruv Sharma instructed field team to test bypassing the boiling cell immediately to restore travel and lift operations. Shiv Uniyal confirmed the steering sensor is already ordered and arriving at Delhi depot today or tomorrow for express dispatch. Shiv also noted Reach central yard holds a 3-ton battery bank from which healthy cells can be dispatched if bypass fails. Ravi Tiwari directed to send clear photos of the battery serial plate.
breakdowns.status: Cell Bypass Test Underway; Steering Sensor In Transit to Delhi; Battery Plate Photo Awaited

breakdowns.site: Tata Micron Site (Sanand) — 3 Reach Trucks Grounded & Battery Cell Cannibalization Protocol
breakdowns.issue: Three reach trucks grounded at Micron due to battery failures, with 6 total bad/dead cells. Previous warranty claim discussions stalled. Supervisor Dheeraj Dubey cited lack of time as technician Deepak was assigned to CG Power project.
breakdowns.action: Jitendra Budhauliya and Shiv Uniyal strictly directed Dheeraj to execute immediate battery cell interchange/cannibalization across the 3 units today. By extracting the 6 defective cells and consolidating all functional cells into 2 machines, 2 reach trucks can be restored to full operation immediately, leaving only 1 unit grounded pending cell procurement.
breakdowns.status: Mandatory Cell Swap Ordered; 2 Machines Restored to Running Today; 1 Unit Quarantined for Spares

breakdowns.site: Bhiwadi Fleet — Machines 507, 506 & 504 Multi-Unit Grounding & Diagnostic Isolation

breakdowns.site: Goa Fleet — Reach Truck Hydraulic Pump Failure & 22-Year-Old Condemned Battery
breakdowns.issue: Goa reach truck grounded due to hydraulic pump failure. Site inspection revealed the traction battery bank is 22 years old, severely degraded, unable to maintain voltage or electrolyte specific gravity under load.
breakdowns.action: Imran Khan deploying technician Sajid to Goa with a replacement hydraulic pump assembly. Complete battery replacement authorized; formal procurement requisition initiated.
breakdowns.status: Technician Sajid Travel Aligned; Replacement Pump Dispatched; Battery Replacement Requisition Approved

breakdowns.site: Bhatinda Site — Genie Z-60 Boom Lift Chassis Wiring Harness Overheating
breakdowns.issue: Genie Z-60 experiencing severe electrical wiring harness overheating on lower chassis/ground control bundle, risking melted insulation, short circuits, and intermittent signal shutdown.
breakdowns.action: Satendra Kumar opened the harness protective ducting to isolate high-resistance splices, degraded wiring, and loose terminal lugs. Complete rewiring, lug crimping, and electrical load testing scheduled for completion today.
breakdowns.status: Harness Disassembled; Rewiring & Thermal Load Testing Underway

directives.title: Strict Google Form Spares Procurement Policy ('No Google Form, No Spares Dispatch')
points: Zero Verbal or Chat Dispatches: Store manager Pardeep Tomar and procurement team will strictly reject any parts requests submitted via personal phone calls, WhatsApp messages, or verbal requests.
Mandatory Form Compliance: Every spares requisition must be entered into the central Google Form with verified part numbers, machine serial number plate photos, and detailed failure symptoms.
End to Informal Exceptions: Field supervisors must adhere 100% to the digital requisition protocol to ensure inventory accuracy and prevent wrong part dispatches.

directives.title: Battery Cannibalization Strategy for Multi-Unit Site Groundings
points: Immediate Fleet Restoration: On sites suffering multiple machine groundings due to partial cell failures (e.g. Micron 3 reach trucks with 6 bad cells), supervisors must immediately swap healthy cells into priority machines.

Maximize Operational Availability: Never leave an entire cluster grounded while waiting for fresh battery procurement; consolidate good cells to ensure maximum units (e.g. 2 out of 3) are operational today.
Quarantine Defective Units: The single machine holding the dead cells will remain quarantined pending fresh cell procurement or warranty settlement.

directives.title: Meeting Discipline, Prior Preparation & Mute Protocols
points: Written Agenda Requirement: Site supervisors must write down all breakdown details, machine numbers, and spares requisitions prior to joining the morning meeting. Piecemeal recall during the call is prohibited.
Audio Discipline: Participants must keep microphones muted when not speaking to eliminate background shop-floor noise and echo.
Supervisory Attendance: All regional supervisors must attend daily morning meetings punctually. Absentees will face direct administrative review.

directives.title: Mandatory CRM Ticket Registration for All Fleet Interventions
points: 100% CRM Reconciliation: All machine breakdowns, tyre replacements, and servicing calls must have an active CRM ticket registered with accurate serial numbers.
Immediate Credential Escalation: Supervisors experiencing CRM login or password difficulties (e.g. Rahul Singh / Dinesh) must resolve access within 1 hour rather than leaving work unlogged.

directives.title: Phased 1-by-1 Maintenance Rotation for Wear & Tear Components
points: Prevent Fleet Grounding: Large-scale refurbishments such as operator seats, tyre changes, and cosmetic repairs across multi-unit fleets must be scheduled 1 machine at a time.
Active Utilization: Operational machines must remain on client duty while individual assemblies are serviced and re-installed sequentially.
